data_actions: Preserve every story, source, claim, evidence record, approval, draft, alert, and diagnostic.
Conditionally mark orphaned queued evidence 9 as superseded by fetched evidence 8 only if the audited duplicate relationship is unchanged.
Retain aggregator discovery timestamps while treating unknown linked-article publication dates as newly surfaced with zero freshness.
Invalidate stale assistance attestations through release-bound policy evaluation; do not enable assistance automatically.
Create no backup, synchronization, deletion, notification activation, or publication side effect.
rollback_boundary: Schema remains 7. Application rollback still requires an installed release whose manifest supports schema 7; runtime data is never rolled back or deleted.
installation_gate: Install only from clean merged private main with a commit-bound validation report and all release checks passed.
